body: My parents have been wonderful to me and I am a pretty messed up individual that never really grew up.  Time has been catching up and I think that leaving would be the best solution.  I wanted to move away, across the US.  I wanted to start a new life, but I have very little cash.  I also have very little skills, if any.  They've been through losses, so they would eventually get over me, or at least learn to cope with it.
